$comment: Tools that are registered in the main session but introduced to the model nowhere:
no promptSnippet, and no mention in the philosophy layers. They are still callable —
their schemas reach the model — but Pi gives the model no steering about when to use
them, which is how `ledger_note` shipped as a capability the Boss never reached for.
This file is a baseline, not an allowlist. check-boss-tool-policy.mjs reports every
entry and fails only on names that are NOT here, so a new one cannot land unnoticed.
Fix an entry by giving the tool a promptSnippet or naming it in a philosophy layer,
then delete it from this list.
secretary_commit is deliberate and expected to stay. It is registered process-wide but
runSecretaryCommit rejects any caller whose PIPIUI_AGENT_ROLE is not closeout-secretary,
which the main session's never is. Introducing it to the Boss would advertise a commit
path the Boss cannot use and must not look for.
subagent_manage reads, scaffolds and installs agent definitions and never enters the
dispatch, desktop or grant paths. Low value to a Boss mid-orchestration, so it is left
unintroduced for now rather than spending prompt on it — revisit if agent authoring
becomes something the Boss is expected to do.
